items.headline: SoftBank closes upsized $11.9B loan, repays $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan, while $10-20B junk-bond roadshow runs through Sept 17
items.note: SoftBank secured a two-year $11.87B loan (upsized from a $10B target, ~20 banks) and a separate $10B margin loan collateralized by its OpenAI stake, while retiring the $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan due Sept 15 — rapid re-leveraging via volatile-equity-backed debt that Bloomberg Intelligence framed as a move to get ahead of AI-leverage concerns before they worsen.

items.headline: Bernstein warns AI-training slowdown could crimp neocloud demand, pressuring highly-levered CoreWeave
items.note: Following Amodei's 'pace the frontier' call for slower AI development, Bernstein flagged risk to data-center demand growth right as CoreWeave carries roughly 14x debt-to-equity leverage and rising interest costs — a demand-side warning for an already debt-heavy neocloud, not yet a realized credit event.
